explanation: Fires only at D1, and only when the previous trial was an a2 choice that reached S2 by a common transition and was rewarded; it is 0 at every GO and D2 step, at D1 after any a1 trial, after any rare transition, and after any unrewarded trial. When it fires the value depends on time in the episode: about 10 in trials 1-12 (7-9 on the first such trial after a break), about 6-8 around trials 28-40, 3-5 around trials 48-56, about 2 around trials 68-71, and 0 after about trial 80.
